author: pro_review

ownership.classification: Author evidence for owned parser/profile/CLI changes; independent read-only generation review is separately scoped below.

scope: Explicit exact v2/local_handoff_v1 declaration, no boolean/version/name aliases; v1/local_stop_v1 and default-off preserved, no database migration is performed here.

Both restart CLI routes delegate one Core operation with exact stable request ID; only exact CompletedControllerHandoff type returns zero. Explicit module/operation/constructor doubles establish CLI transport behavior, not actual process closure or successor authority.
Global controller_request_id destination is distinct from replication request_id. Restart -c placement is consistent; operator timeout does not rewrite loaded training timeout or fingerprint.

Claimed ORZE_CONTROLLER_HANDOFF_FD is metadata-checked before early CLI paths; actual channel admission is called after loaded argument validation/runtime pin and before sentinel/GPU/Orze. Non-None entry return is refused; None alone cannot confer the separate private namespace admission.
V2 start/enable/task-resume/restart--foreground remain unsupported. No Pro Director, cross-host, reallocation, legacy adoption or automatic controller recovery implementation.

notes: The legacy and v2 global -c failures share one existing parser root cause; they are not two independent defects.
The 33 initial cases had one erroneous test argument before correction, not a historical product red.
The candidate-only entry False case is a new explicit return-contract requirement, not an old release capability.
Repeated targeted runs and snapshot replays overlap and are not summed.

static_audit.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, collections, hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
paths=['src/orze/core/controller_profile.py','src/orze/cli.py','tests/test_controller_handoff_profile.py','tests/test_controller_handoff_cli.py','tests/test_controller_handoff_entry_boundaries.py']
snapshots=sorted(root.glob('docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e2d-*'))
# Limit this author audit to this author's five complete snapshots.
owned=['v1-05c2e2d-before-controller-profile.py','v1-05c2e2d-before-cli.py','v1-05c2e2d-before-cli-route-and-entry.py','v1-05c2e2d-first-handoff-cli-tests.py','v1-05c2e2d-first-cli-route-entry-tests.py']
def asserts(path):
    return [ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(path.read_bytes())) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert)]
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for src,name in zip(paths[:2],owned[:2]):
    snapshot=root/'docs/evidence/snapshots'/name
    assert snapshot.read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show','e0b8eb79697d26beefe92546166a828b93f035c8:'+src])
for name in owned: ast.parse((root/'docs/evidence/snapshots'/name).read_bytes())
a=asserts(root/'docs/evidence/snapshots'/owned[3]);b=asserts(root/paths[3]);assert a==b
c=collections.Counter(asserts(root/'docs/evidence/snapshots'/owned[4]));d=collections.Counter(asserts(root/paths[4]))
assert sum((c-d).values())==sum((d-c).values())==1
print(json.dumps({'files':{p:sha(root/p) for p in paths},'snapshots':{str(Path('docs/evidence/snapshots')/p):sha(root/'docs/evidence/snapshots'/p) for p in owned},'assert_counts':{p:len(asserts(root/p)) for p in paths[2:]},'first_cli_asserts_preserved':len(a),'entry_witness_assert_sites_changed':1,'entry_original_asserts_preserved':sum((c&d).values()),'baseline_modules_byteequal':2},sort_keys=True))
PY
